3: na rUpamasyeha tathopalabhyate nAnto na chAdirna cha sampratiShThA
4: tataH padaM tatparimArgitavyaM yasmingatA na nivartanti bhUyaH
tameva chAdyaM puruShaM prapadye yataH pravR^ittiH prasR^itA purANI
6: na tadbhAsayate sUryo na shashA~Nko na pAvakaH
yadgatvA na nivartante taddhAma paramaM mama
9: shrotraM chakShuH sparshanaM cha rasanaM ghrANameva cha
10: utkrAmantaM sthitaM vApi bhu~njAnaM vA guNAnvitam
13: puShNAmi chauShadhIH sarvAH somo bhUtvA rasAtmakaH
15: sarvasya chAhaM hR^idi sanniviShTo mattaH smR^itirj~nAnamapohanaM cha
16: dvAvimau puruShau loke kSharashchAkShara eva cha
18: ato.asmi loke vede cha prathitaH puruShottamaH

6: dvau bhUtasargau loke.asmindaiva Asura eva cha
daivo vistarashaH prokta AsuraM pArtha me shR^iNu
7: pravR^ittiM cha nivR^ittiM cha janA na vidurAsurAH
na shauchaM nApi chAchAro na satyaM teShu vidyate
18: aha~NkAraM balaM darpaM kAmaM krodhaM cha saMshritAH
23: na sa siddhimavApnoti na sukhaM na parAM gatim

1: teShAM niShThA tu kA kR^iShNa sattvamAho rajastamaH
2: trividhA bhavati shraddhA dehinAM sA svabhAvajA
sAttvikI rAjasI chaiva tAmasI cheti tAM shR^iNu
3: shraddhAmayo.ayaM puruShaH yo yachChraddhaH sa eva saH
5: ashAstravihitaM ghoraM tapyante ye tapo janAH
8: rasyAH snigdhAH sthirA hR^idyAH AhArAH sAttvikapriyAH
10: yAtayAmaM gatarasaM pUti paryuShitaM cha yat
12: abhisandhAya tu phalaM dambhArthamapi chaiva yat
ijyate bharatashreShTha taM yaj~naM viddhi rAjasam
15: anudvegakaraM vAkyaM satyaM priyahitaM cha yat
20: deshe kAle cha pAtre cha taddAnaM sAttvikaM smR^itam
21: dIyate cha parikliShTaM taddAnaM rAjasaM smR^itam
26: prashaste karmaNi tathA sachChabdaH pArtha yujyate
27: yaj~ne tapasi dAne cha sthitiH saditi chochyate
28: ashraddhayA hutaM dattaM tapastaptaM kR^itaM cha yat
asadityuchyate pArtha na cha tatpretya no iha

2: kAmyAnAM karmaNAM nyAsaM sa.nnyAsaM kavayo viduH
4: nishchayaM shR^iNu me tatra tyAge bharatasattama
6: etAnyapi tu karmANi sa~NgaM tyaktvA phalAni cha
8: sa kR^itvA rAjasaM tyAgaM naiva tyAgaphalaM labhet
9: sa~NgaM tyaktvA phalaM chaiva sa tyAgaH sAttviko mataH
11: na hi dehabhR^itA shakyaM tyaktuM karmANyasheShataH
12: aniShTamiShTaM mishraM cha trividhaM karmaNaH phalam
bhavatyatyAginAM pretya na tu sa.nnyAsinAM kvachit
14: adhiShThAnaM tathA kartA karaNaM cha pR^ithagvidham
15: nyAyyaM vA viparItaM vA pa~nchaite tasya hetavaH
16: tatraivaM sati kartAramAtmAnaM kevalaM tu yaH
17: yasya nAhaMkR^ito bhAvo buddhiryasya na lipyate
hatvApi sa imAMllokAnna hanti na nibadhyate
19: j~nAnaM karma cha kartA cha tridhaiva guNabhedataH
21: vetti sarveShu bhUteShu tajj~nAnaM viddhi rAjasam
24: yattu kAmepsunA karma sAhaMkAreNa vA punaH
28: viShAdI dIrghasUtrI cha kartA tAmasa uchyate
30: pravR^ittiM cha nivR^ittiM cha kAryAkArye bhayAbhaye
bandhaM mokShaM cha yA vetti buddhiH sA pArtha sAttvikI
31: yayA dharmamadharmaM cha kAryaM chAkAryameva cha
34: prasa~Ngena phalAkA~NkShI dhR^itiH sA pArtha rAjasI
35: yayA svapnaM bhayaM shokaM viShAdaM madameva cha
na vimu~nchati durmedhA dhR^itiH sA tAmasI matA
36: sukhaM tvidAnIM trividhaM shR^iNu me bharatarShabha
40: na tadasti pR^ithivyAM vA divi deveShu vA punaH
45: sve sve karmaNyabhirataH saMsiddhiM labhate naraH
48: sahajaM karma kaunteya sadoShamapi na tyajet
50: siddhiM prApto yathA brahma tathApnoti nibodha me
samAsenaiva kaunteya niShThA j~nAnasya yA parA
51: buddhyA vishuddhayA yukto dhR^ityAtmAnaM niyamya cha
53: ahaMkAraM balaM darpaM kAmaM krodhaM parigraham
54: brahmabhUtaH prasannAtmA na shochati na kA~NkShati
samaH sarveShu bhUteShu madbhaktiM labhate parAm
55: tato mAM tattvato j~nAtvA vishate tadanantaram
64: sarvaguhyatamaM bhUyaH shR^iNu me paramaM vachaH
iShTo.asi me dR^iDhamiti tato vakShyAmi te hitam
65: manmanA bhava madbhakto madyAjI mAM namaskuru
mAmevaiShyasi satyaM te pratijAne priyo.asi me
66: ahaM tvA sarvapApebhyo mokShayiShyAmi mA shuchaH
67: na chAshushrUShave vAchyaM na cha mAM yo.abhyasUyati
69: bhavitA na cha me tasmAdanyaH priyataro bhuvi
70: adhyeShyate cha ya imaM dharmyaM saMvAdamAvayoH
77: vismayo me mahAnrAjan hR^iShyAmi cha punaH punaH
78: yatra yogeshvaraH kR^iShNo yatra pArtho dhanurdharaH
